# TODO List API

REST API for managing todos. Node.js + Express + SQLite (better-sqlite3).

## Install

```bash
npm install
```

## Run

```bash
npm start          # listens on port 3000 (override with PORT env var)
```

## Test

```bash
npm test           # runs Vitest against an in-memory DB (exit 0 = all green)
```

## Endpoints

| Method | Path         | Description                                      |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| POST   | /todos       | Create a todo `{ title, done? }`                 |
| GET    | /todos       | List todos (optional `?done=true\|false` filter) |
| GET    | /todos/:id   | Get one todo                                     |
| PUT    | /todos/:id   | Update `title` and/or `done`                     |
| DELETE | /todos/:id   | Delete a todo (204 on success)                   |
